messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] rstan repo
parts:
On 5/23/13 8:33 PM, Jiqiang Guo wrote:
> I have created a rstan repo on github for stan-dev and copied the original rstan folder to the new repo.

I think this'll be easier to manage going forward.
Especially now that so many people are banging away on
Stan.

I love that you kept the history and made Stan a submodule.

The new README looks good. (We could get fancier for both
Stan and RStan at some point.)

I saw the license note on the README. I also think we should
have a license in the repo itself.

When should we delete the rstan directory out of Stan itself?
Should the delete just be another pull request? (I'm imagining
hundreds of pages of red code.)

- Bob

messages.author: ab7b24da45678eac
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] rstan repo
parts:
Thanks for taking a look. I will add the license file.

I would request a pull to delete rstan from stan repo, then the ball to delete rstan or how/when to delete is not at my court.

Jiqiang
